items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 20:1
items.html: The vessels from the Chazeh and below of the seven lower [Sefirot] of Nekudim, which are the aspect of the Chazeh and below of the Partzuf of the Nekudim of SAG of AK, which came out below the point of the conclusion of the second restriction and were made into the aspect of an empty void, no longer fit to receive light, as is known — they are the source from which the vessels of the Achoraim [posteriors] of ZON were sorted. However, before the breaking of the vessels they were not fit at all to receive the upper light again, being already found below the concluding Malchut. But because of the breaking of the vessels, in which the seven lower [Sefirot] of Nekudim were broken front and back, and also the vessels of the face descended to BYA and died together with the vessels of the posterior — then all the vessels and the sparks mingled with one another, until there is no spark among them that is not included from all of ABYA, that is, both from all the vessels of the face and from all the vessels of the posterior, for so they mingled and became included one in the other.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 20:2
items.html: And behold, at first only the vessels of the face were sorted, alone by themselves, and from them were corrected the aspects of the VAK and the point of ZA, which are all face [Panim], and no diminution will ever befall them again. For their breaking from the beginning was not because of themselves, but because of their sorting together with the Achoraim. Therefore, after they were sorted once by themselves, the external ones have no more grip in them. And afterward were sorted the Achoraim, which are included from the aspect of the vessels of the face — that is, at the time that the vessels of the face were in their breaking in BYA, aspects from the vessels of the posterior were included in them — and these were sorted also to Atzilut and became the vessels of the Achoraim of ZON. (Part 1, Page 954, subheading "and in their light").
